name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
ministry_department: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, GoI
benefit: ₹6,000 per year directly transferred to bank account in 3 equal installments of ₹2,000.
documentsRequired: Aadhaar Card linked with Bank Account
Land Ownership Document (7/12 extract / Khasra / Khatoni)

name: PMFBY (Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana)
ministry_department: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, GoI
benefit: Comprehensive insurance coverage against non-preventable natural risks from pre-sowing to post-harvest. Farmer premium capped at 1.5% for Rabi, 2.0% for Kharif, 5.0% for Commercial crops.
documentsRequired: Land Record / Sowing Certificate (Patwari / Gram Sevak verification)

name: PMKSY - Per Drop More Crop (Drip/Sprinkler Subsidy)
official_name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (Per Drop More Crop)
ministry_department: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare and Ministry of Jal Shakti, GoI
benefit: Up to 55% subsidy for Small & Marginal Farmers (up to 5 acres) and 45% for other farmers for installing Drip / Micro-Sprinkler irrigation systems.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
ministry_department: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, GoI & Reserve Bank of India
benefit: Short-term crop production credit up to ₹3,00,000 at a low effective interest rate of 4% per annum (with timely repayment prompt incentive).

name: SMAM (Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization)
ministry_department: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, GoI
benefit: 40% to 50% financial subsidy on purchase of Tractors, Power Tillers, Rotavators, Seed Drills, Drone Sprayers, and Harvesters.

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
official_name: National Mission on Sustainable Agriculture (NMSA) - Soil Health Card
ministry_department: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, GoI
benefit: Free 12-parameter soil fertility analysis (N, P, K, S, Zn, Fe, Cu, Mn, B, pH, EC, OC) with tailored crop-specific fertilizer recommendations every 2 years.
